about: The Worca Rail design system as data: what a page can be built from, for a tool or an agent. The rules are docs/rail/; when this file and those differ, the file there wins and this one is fixed in the same change. Each component is drawn in the gallery (plans/rail/prototype/components.html) and on the generated Worca Rail page.
howToBuild: Pick the page's pattern from `featureKinds`: what the feature is picks it (docs/rail/build.md › build.default).

For each thing the person must see or do, find its need below (a component, a logic entry, or an element under its family's `also`); use it in that pattern's slot. A need with no entry is a question for a person, then build.teach.

A component or logic with `code` is built in code: import it from ui/public/design-system/components/index.mjs and call it; never write its markup. A need with no component in code: add the component there first, with its test and its `code` entry.
Write the words by the rules in docs/rail/: state words, labels of 1–3 words, failures as `Could not …`, the reason, `Nothing changed.`
Draw every state: empty, loading, could not load, a failed step, an unexpected break, a lost connection, and 375px.
Set no look of your own: no size, colour, corner or shadow; they come with the component.

Lay it out narrow by docs/rail/narrow.md: at 520px of content (560px for a settings row) side by side stacks on the same text edge, the action slot moves under the state word and its extra buttons fold into ⋯; nothing is dropped; names keep one line with an ellipsis and a tooltip; a branch or path loses its middle and keeps its start and last part (feat/unifi…-breadcrumb).
Name every page, menu item, section head and row by Small rules › Names: the thing, 1–3 words, one thing one name; ds-check reads them.
What a page needed and the design system did not have is added to it first: the rule, the catalog entry, the component in code with its test and gallery example
Pass the gate: plans/rail/prototype/gates/ds-check.mjs and the page's sweep.

patterns.name: A place
patterns.for: a kind of work you browse, set up and come back to: Marketplace, Workflows, a new place
slots: bar: ways in, not items (listController): Yours and Browse, each way counting on its row; the + makes a thing; an action is never a row

home: PlaceHead with its title and facts; a state word, one action and ⋯ only when something needs you; then For you (PluginCards, Worca's reason first), then shelves named for what you want (CenterShelf, PluginCards two to a row, each thing once); then what the place keeps, as a SettingsSection
way page: PlaceHead with the center crumb; `Showing [sort ▾] first` (SentencePicker); six cards, then Show N more; an empty way is an EmptyState with its next step

item page: PlaceHead with the center crumb, its state word, one action and ⋯; one step at a time under the head (ConfirmStrip, or confirmForm when it holds a short form); then what it holds, as SettingsSections of SettingsRows; an unknown id is NotFound

states: all five, even where the example skips one: empty (emptyState with its next step), loading (one emptyState line after 300ms, never a spinner), could not load (emptyState with error and Reload this part), not found (notFound for an id that names nothing, never the home instead), 375px (narrow.md)

patterns.name: A thing's page
patterns.for: any page about one thing that is not a task: a schedule, a project, a workflow, a feature, a workspace
slots: top bar: trail, its first crumb the center's home; at its right nothing about the thing
PlaceHead: title, its facts on one line, then its state on the cards' rail with one action and ⋯ (panel.place-head)
what it holds: cards, rows and SettingsSections
its composer, as the page's last line

patterns.name: A task's page
patterns.for: a task (run) and a group: the one exception; its card is the model
slots: top bar: trail; at its right nothing about the thing: the pager, the connection line, the shell's own search, Pulse and New run
title
metadata line: facts as phrases, then TagGroup; a fact that is also a setting is a SentencePicker in its phrase
StatusLine with the action slot and ⋯ (empty slot when the state calls for no step)
progress: Stepper and StepRows; questions as OptionList under their step
Figures
Tabs

patterns.name: A list page
patterns.for: Runs; never for a new tracked thing, which is A list in its place (build.default)
slots: top bar: trail
title row with the page's one action at its right (New schedule)
A list

patterns.name: A list
slots: the sentence of what it shows (SentencePicker): Showing [what ▾] from [where ▾] by [grouping ▾], each choice with its count; the same in every list, never a filter button or View menu
sections in a fixed order, empty sections not drawn, a line where each section after the first starts; a long section shows its newest rows, then Show N more opens the rest in place; never folded
ListRows; a fact in a row is text, never a second link; the row's own actions in a ⋯ at its right end
EmptyState when empty

patterns.name: A side column

its work as cards on a 760px column under the shared card head: run card, command group (a failure opens itself), graph well

patterns.name: A panel

head: Tabs with counts as captions, ⋯ at the right
body that scrolls under a head that stays

patterns.name: A settings tab

SettingsSections, each a Heading (15/600) and its one head action
